name: orgs
title: Organizations
summary: People create organizations, invite others by email or link, and manage members as owners, admins and members.
stitch: Decide what an organization is called in the product (team, club, workspace) and use that word in copy; keep the API names.
Decide who may create organizations (default: any active account, 10 per hour) and whether a new account must join or create one first.
Scope your own tables and routes to an org: org_id with ON DELETE CASCADE in an app migration, orgs.Require("member"|"admin"|"owner") on an {orgID} URL param, useActiveOrg() on the client.
Set PUBLIC_WEB_URL so invite emails link to /invites/<token> (public on web and mobile; joining resumes after sign-in and consent).
Mobile: configure universal links for PUBLIC_WEB_URL/invites/* if invite emails should open the app (the app route is invites/[token]).
The org switcher sits in the account menu (web) and Settings → Organizations (web and mobile); add OrgSwitcher (web/src/features/orgs) to the top bar if the product is org-centric.
